title: The chamber the brine kept
interpretation: All displayed surfaces are native mineral concentration isosurfaces; full native scalar precision retained in OpenVDB DoubleGrid for Float64 mineral, with no downsampling or invented internal mesh. An optional recorded planar observational cut removes the x-greater portion without inventing cap geometry. Without cut_x the entire extracted surface is retained. Camera cropping is photographic framing. Coordinates are uniformly divided by physical half-extent for photographic staging. Residual A/(A+B) trilinearly sampled at native mineral vertices selects copper-to-verdigris color; saved absolute phase sets roughness 0.40–0.62 and residual ratio sets metallic response 0.12–0.62. These are chosen optical mappings, not an oxidation solve. The optional phase-metal transfer maps actual signed phase to navy/umber base, metallic response and 180–400nm chosen thin-film interference; actual remaining reagents modulate brightness and roughness, while residual A ratio adds copper. These film/metal assignments are artistic optics, not simulated oxide or film thickness. The selected surface shaders and photographic floor/lights are optical choices, not calibrated material optics. A lower-concentration clear film is included only when no_wet is false.
